import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { Worker } from 'node:worker_threads';
import { AppError } from '../errors.js';
const failed = (code = 'query_failed', status = 503) => new AppError(status, code, code === 'query_busy' ? '页面读取请求过多，请稍后重试。' : code === 'query_timeout' ? '页面读取超时，请重试。' : '页面读取服务暂时不可用，请重试。');
/** One executing query and at most 32 waiting queries; deadlines start at admission. */
export class QueryClient {
    bootstrap;
    authority;
    ownerAlive;
    #worker;
    #active;
    #queue = [];
    #controls = [];
    #ready = false;
    #closed = false;
    #restarted = false;
    #restart;
    #closePromise;
    #terminations = new Set();
    constructor(bootstrap, authority, ownerAlive) {
        this.bootstrap = bootstrap;
        this.authority = authority;
        this.ownerAlive = ownerAlive;
    }
    static async start(bootstrap, authority, ownerAlive) {
        const client = new QueryClient(bootstrap, authority, ownerAlive);
        try {
            await client.spawn();
            return client;
        }
        catch (error) {
            await client.close();
            throw error;
        }
    }
    /** Trusted Node fixture attachment; renderer contracts never expose Workers. */
    static async connect(worker, bootstrap, authority, ownerAlive) {
        const client = new QueryClient(bootstrap, authority, ownerAlive);
        try {
            await client.attach(worker);
            return client;
        }
        catch (error) {
            await client.close();
            throw error;
        }
    }
    get pendingCount() { return this.#queue.length + this.#controls.length + Number(!!this.#active); }
    spawn() {
        const worker = new Worker(new URL(import.meta.url.endsWith('.ts') ? './query-worker.ts' : './query-worker.js', import.meta.url), {
            workerData: { bootstrap: this.bootstrap, authority: this.authority }, execArgv: [], name: 'marlin-core-query', stdout: true, stderr: true,
        });
        return this.attach(worker);
    }
    attach(worker) {
        this.#worker = worker;
        worker.stdout.resume();
        worker.stderr.resume();
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            let settled = false;
            const timer = setTimeout(() => { reject(failed('query_start_timeout')); this.fault(worker); }, 30000);
            const fault = () => {
                if (!settled) {
                    settled = true;
                    clearTimeout(timer);
                    reject(failed());
                }
                this.fault(worker);
            };
            worker.on('error', fault);
            worker.on('messageerror', fault);
            worker.on('exit', () => { if (!this.#closed && this.#worker === worker)
                fault(); });
            worker.on('message', (message) => {
                if (this.#worker !== worker || this.#closed)
                    return;
                if (!message || message.protocol !== 1) {
                    fault();
                    return;
                }
                if (message.type === 'ready') {
                    if (settled || message.generation !== this.bootstrap.generation) {
                        fault();
                        return;
                    }
                    settled = true;
                    clearTimeout(timer);
                    this.#ready = true;
                    resolve();
                    return;
                }
                if (message.type === 'startup-error') {
                    fault();
                    return;
                }
                if (message.type === 'closed')
                    return;
                if (!this.#ready || message.type !== 'result' || !this.#active || message.id !== this.#active.id || message.generation !== this.bootstrap.generation || message.epoch !== this.#active.epoch) {
                    fault();
                    return;
                }
                const query = this.#active;
                this.#active = undefined;
                this.release(query);
                if (!this.ownerAlive())
                    query.reject(failed('owner_failed'));
                else if (query.epoch !== Atomics.load(new BigUint64Array(this.authority), 0).toString())
                    query.reject(new AppError(409, 'auth_superseded', '登录状态已改变，请重新操作。'));
                else {
                    try {
                        if (Date.now() >= query.deadline)
                            throw failed('query_timeout', 408);
                        if (query.signal?.aborted)
                            throw query.signal.reason;
                        // The coordinator validates and CASes the shared attempt here,
                        // before resolving or yielding to another authority intent.
                        if (query.control && message.response.status === 200)
                            query.authorized?.(message.target);
                        query.resolve(message.response);
                    }
                    catch (error) {
                        query.reject(error);
                    }
                }
                this.pump();
            });
        });
    }
    release(query) { clearTimeout(query.timer); query.signal?.removeEventListener('abort', query.abort); }
    fault(worker, error = failed()) {
        if (this.#worker !== worker || this.#closed)
            return;
        this.#worker = undefined;
        this.#ready = false;
        for (const query of [...this.#queue.splice(0), ...this.#controls.splice(0), ...(this.#active ? [this.#active] : [])]) {
            this.release(query);
            query.reject(error);
        }
        this.#active = undefined;
        const terminated = worker.terminate().catch(() => -1);
        this.#terminations.add(terminated);
        void terminated.finally(() => this.#terminations.delete(terminated));
        if (!this.#restarted && this.ownerAlive()) {
            this.#restarted = true;
            this.#restart = terminated.then(async () => { if (!this.#closed && this.ownerAlive())
                await this.spawn(); }).catch(() => { });
        }
    }
    pump() {
        if (this.#closed || !this.#ready || !this.#worker || this.#active || !this.#queue.length && !this.#controls.length)
            return;
        const query = (this.#controls.length ? this.#controls : this.#queue).shift();
        this.#active = query;
        const message = { protocol: 1, type: 'query', id: query.id, generation: this.bootstrap.generation, epoch: query.epoch, deadline: query.deadline, request: query.request, binding: query.binding, ...(query.control ? { operation: 'cancel-preflight' } : {}) };
        try {
            this.#worker.postMessage(message);
        }
        catch {
            this.fault(this.#worker, failed('query_input_uncloneable', 400));
        }
    }
    dispatch(request, binding, epoch, signal) {
        return this.enqueue(request, binding, epoch, signal);
    }
    cancelPreflight(request, binding, epoch, authorized, signal) {
        return this.enqueue(request, binding, epoch, signal, authorized);
    }
    enqueue(request, binding, epoch, signal, authorized) {
        if (signal?.aborted)
            return Promise.reject(signal.reason);
        if (this.#closed || !this.#ready || !this.ownerAlive())
            return Promise.reject(failed());
        const control = !!authorized, queue = control ? this.#controls : this.#queue;
        if (control ? queue.length + Number(!!this.#active?.control) >= 8 : queue.length >= 32)
            return Promise.reject(failed('query_busy', 429));
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            const query = { id: randomUUID(), request, binding, epoch, deadline: Date.now() + 15000, resolve, reject, signal, control, authorized,
                timer: setTimeout(() => {
                    if (this.#active === query && this.#worker)
                        this.fault(this.#worker, failed('query_timeout', 408));
                    else {
                        const index = queue.indexOf(query);
                        if (index !== -1)
                            queue.splice(index, 1);
                        this.release(query);
                        reject(failed('query_timeout', 408));
                    }
                }, 15000),
                abort: () => {
                    reject(signal?.reason);
                    const index = queue.indexOf(query);
                    if (index !== -1) {
                        queue.splice(index, 1);
                        this.release(query);
                    }
                    // A synchronous SQLite query cannot consume an abort message. Keep its
                    // slot/deadline until terminal response, and discard its late Promise result.
                },
            };
            queue.push(query);
            signal?.addEventListener('abort', query.abort, { once: true });
            this.pump();
        });
    }
    close() { return this.#closePromise ??= this.closeWorker(); }
    async closeWorker() {
        this.#closed = true;
        this.#ready = false;
        for (const query of [...this.#queue.splice(0), ...this.#controls.splice(0), ...(this.#active ? [this.#active] : [])]) {
            this.release(query);
            query.reject(failed('query_closed'));
        }
        this.#active = undefined;
        const worker = this.#worker;
        this.#worker = undefined;
        if (worker) {
            const exited = new Promise(resolve => { if (worker.threadId === -1)
                resolve();
            else
                worker.once('exit', () => resolve()); });
            const timer = setTimeout(() => { void worker.terminate(); }, 2500);
            try {
                worker.postMessage({ protocol: 1, type: 'close' });
                await exited;
            }
            finally {
                clearTimeout(timer);
            }
        }
        await this.#restart;
        await Promise.allSettled([...this.#terminations]);
    }
}
